label: friction after
goal: Buy one Trail Backpack with standard delivery. Your details: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city Testville, ZIP 99999, country United States. Pay by card: name on card Alex Morgan, card number 4111 1111 1111 1111, expiry 12/30, security code 123. Agree to the terms of sale. You do not want newsletters or promotions.

outcome.reason: The order is confirmed by the payment oracle.

findings.problem: About 27 navigation links before the products; the skip link moves focus to main but the cart link is before it, so after adding to cart I had to Tab all the way around the page to reach the Cart link
Add to cart gives no focus change; the confirmation is only a status message that is easy to miss

findings.page: Your cart - Pine and Peak Outfitters
findings.problem: A newsletter popup appeared on the cart page and grabbed keyboard focus on arrival, interrupting the task; I had to close it before continuing
The Skip to main content link had to be used on every page to avoid tabbing through 27 nav links; focus after page load is at the top each time
Embedded PayPal button is a plain div with no clear role or label; card fields start with an optional Cardholder Name field and the fields give little context
After pressing Pay, no visible or announced change happened immediately; I had to re-read the page to find the confirmation

findings.problem: About 27 navigation links before the products; the skip link moves focus to main but the cart link is before it, so after adding to cart I had to Tab all the way around the page to reach the Cart link
Add to cart gives no focus change; the confirmation is only a status message that is easy to miss

findings.page: Your cart - Pine and Peak Outfitters
findings.problem: A newsletter popup appeared on the cart page and grabbed keyboard focus on arrival, interrupting the task; I had to close it before continuing
The Skip to main content link had to be used on every page to avoid tabbing through 27 nav links; focus after page load is at the top each time
Embedded PayPal button is a plain div with no clear role or label; card fields start with an optional Cardholder Name field and the fields give little context
After pressing Pay, no visible or announced change happened immediately; I had to re-read the page to find the confirmation
